data.name: Mortie College
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Mortie College!

College life has never been this complicated!

Meet Martin, a charming, tech-savvy young man stepping into a world filled with colorful personalities, new friendships, romantic possibilities, and more drama than he ever expected.

Alongside his close friend Ashley, Martin begins a new chapter of his life at Mortie College. But things quickly become complicated when he catches the attention of several beautiful and intriguing women.

And while Martin might be a genius with computers, understanding romance is an entirely different challenge!

Friendship, Flirting & Drama

From awkward romantic encounters to hilarious misunderstandings, Mortie College combines lighthearted comedy with emotional storytelling.

Meet a growing cast of unique characters, each with their own personalities, relationships, secrets, and struggles.

Some will make you laugh. Some might break your heart. And others might surprise you when you least expect it.

A Story Beyond Martin

Mortie College isn't just about one person.

Experience moments involving different characters, discover their relationships, and witness events that unfold even when Martin isn't around.

Because at Mortie College, everyone has their own story.

What to Expect

  • Story-driven visual novel featuring character-focused storytelling.

  • Romance and flirting with awkward, funny, and heartfelt moments.

  • Comedy and drama ranging from ridiculous situations to emotional conflicts.

  • A colorful cast of students and other personalities with their own stories.

  • Voice acting bringing the characters and conversations to life.

  • An evolving story with new relationships, conflicts, and surprises.

Welcome to Your New College Life!

Love, friendship, jealousy, laughter, and heartbreak...

At Mortie College, the biggest challenge isn't passing your exams. It's surviving the drama!

Developed by Mor10 Productions.

data.short_description: Welcome to Mortie College! Follow Martin as he navigates college life filled with friendship, romance, awkward flirting, hilarious encounters, jealousy, and unexpected drama. A story-driven visual novel where every character has a story to tell!

content_descriptors.notes: Mortie College contains occasional strong language, depictions of tobacco use, mild implied violence, and romantic or suggestive flirting between adult characters. Some characters wear revealing clothing. The game does not contain nudity or explicit sexual activity.
